suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented renal malignancy/renal tumor treated with partial or radical nephrectomy, with separately documented new or materially worsened postoperative CKD satisfying chronicity criteria. PMID 27614693 specifically supports comparative renal outcomes in cT1b/cT2 renal-tumor cohorts, with greater postoperative renal-function loss and CKD risk after radical versus partial nephrectomy. Do not infer CKD from kidney cancer alone, do not treat transient postoperative AKI as CKD, and consider preoperative renal function and other CKD risk factors when assessing an individual case. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Kidney / Renal Cancer
Independent diagnosis of Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
